ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
PORTRAITS & LIGHT

STUDY 031
Sun-Washed Blonde in Black
Rights check
Source: 24535.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight blonde hair
parted at the side and fine loose strands catching the
light looks directly at the camera. She wears a fitted
black mock-neck top with a subtle diagonal seam. Her
skin is natural, with light freckles and a soft pink lip.
Bright, overexposed sunlight behind her, with blurred
green foliage. Soft, natural palette of ivory, gold, and
deep black. Natural and direct, in the style of a 35mm
film portrait.
Natural, soft, direct
WORKING NOTES
- The overexposed daylight and fine hair strands create
the soft film look.
- Use 'natural skin texture' to keep the realism.
